name: Leanna Dawn
source:
As a recently appointed Mage-Knight, Leanna is sent to investigate rumors of a strange energy influx in Meadowhill. After a few days of searching, she is surprised by what–or more accurately, who–is the cause. Leanna’s maturity and grace makes up for her inexperience as a mage, although every so often her youthful spirit shines through.

[From official website]
